title: ‘Wired to Steal’: How Neuroscience Can Explain Zionism and Settler Colonialism
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
What does the brain tell us about settler colonialism?

That's the question at the heart of the groundbreaking new book, 'Wired to
Steal: Zionism and the Shaping of the Western Mind.'

Co-written by award-winning photographer and doctor of neuroscience **Yoav
Litvin** and acclaimed anti-Zionist Israeli historian **Ilan Papp e**, 'Wired
to Steal' combines their decades of experience to delve into the psyche of
Zionism and settler colonialism.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

In a new '**Mehdi Unfiltered** ' interview, the pair breaks down how
neuroscience can explain prevalent support for the genocide among Israelis,
how Zionism manipulates fear, and whether the "end of Zionism" is near.

"**I think the disassociation of Jewish communities from Zionism is becoming
more prevalent** ," Pappe tells **Mehdi**.

They also discuss the recent elections in Israel and why a new government in
Israel wouldn't do anything to alleviate the hardships of Palestinians in Gaza
and the West Bank.

"**I don 't know what's worse**," Litvin says. "**A unity government, which
would potentially renew the bombings on Iran, or the Palestinian Israeli
citizens who would join the government and thereby normalize the genocide**."
